title: Compute a lexicographic Groebner basis and normal form for three quadrics

source.citation: Janko Boehm, Wolfram Decker, and Frank-Olaf Schreyer, Commutative Algebra and Algebraic Geometry using OSCAR, arXiv:2404.12085

translation.notes: The source's three generators and displayed reduced lexicographic basis are transcribed as mathematics. Noether recomputes the basis and a companion normal form; no OSCAR code is copied.
